final: WITH g AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS st, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS a, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS oa FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(g.n) AS avg_group_count, AVG(g.a - o.oa) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.a > o.oa
